tex_content.html:
Remark
[Closure of a cell need not be a subcomplex] ↗ def:subcomplex \group CW Complexes

The preceding construction shows that a cell closure, and more generally the closure of a union of cells, need not be a subcomplex. In many standard CW structures, however, the closure of every union of cells is a subcomplex.
